Definition: from G1909 and a cognate of G2240; to arrive upon, i.e. extend to:--reach.
BiblicalUsage: Ephikneomai means to reach, to extend to. Paul says he will not boast beyond his measure, but according to the measure God distributed to him — a measure to reach even unto the Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: God gives each of us a measure to reach, and faithfulness is reaching as far as He measured, no further and no less.
